doctrine: A grade here is a provenance grade about the benchmark, never a safety verdict about a model.
Every claim below is sourced and checkable; where evidence is absent the cell says so.
We grade ourselves on the same grid — the GSPC row carries its own known gaps.

scorecards.reproducibility: Practice prompt set public; official set uses rotating reserve prompts — full official run not byte-reproducible by design, and AILuminate says so

scorecards.contamination_disclosure: YES — practice/official split with reserve rotation is the published mitigation
scorecards.model_version_specificity: System-under-test identified per run; reference model is a floating baseline, so grades are not comparable across time
scorecards.correction_behavior: Versioned releases (v1.0 → v1.1); errata via MLCommons channels
scorecards.signature_availability: NONE — reports are unsigned; no content addressing
